text: sorry  im not sure i see the density painter i see a grass tile type and a dry grass but none that says this is a dense patch vs a non dense one
resolution: Fixed the density tiles not appearing: I'd added grassSparse/grassLush only to game/kinds/tiles.ts, but the PAINTER reads a SEPARATE tile table — world/tileKinds.ts (definitions) + design.ts (the TileKind union); BrushRail.tsx maps world/tileKinds TILE_KINDS into the swatch rail. Added grassSparse ('Grass (Sparse)') and grassLush ('Grass (Lush)') to design.ts union AND world/tileKinds.ts, appended LAST in the same order as game/kinds/tiles.ts so all three index spaces stay aligned. Pointed grassPopulation's density-by-index lookup at world/tileKinds TILE_KINDS (the table the painter encodes landform cells against) so it's correct even if the two tables drift. Density lives in GRASS_DENSITY (grassSparse=3, grass/grassDry=7, grassLush=16 blades/cell); both grass sources read it per cell. hmsc-int rebuilt clean, boot self-shot PASS, bundle confirms the new kinds. world_loader needs no rebuild (density is bake-side TS).
